_meta.description: kind: config — member 1 of 11 in the bookings-pipelinq-customer-bridge chain (ADR-032). Declares the optional pipelinqContactId link on the Appointment schema so member 03+ can fetch the pipelinq Contact profile and surface it in detail views. The field stores a pipelinq Contact externalId (KvK for orgs, opaque pipelinq id for individuals — design D1). Additive merge via SettingsService:deepMergeConfig (ADR-037).

pipelinqContactId.description: Optional pipelinq Contact externalId linking this booking to the authoritative customer record in pipelinq (KvK for organisations, opaque pipelinq id for individuals — design D1). Null when the booking has no linked pipelinq Contact; detail views render without a customer profile card in that case (member 06). Many bookings MAY reference the same Contact (non-unique). The HTTP read paths land in members 03-04; this member only declares the link.
pipelinqContactId.title: Pipelinq Contact ID
